name: FOLIO
description: A human-annotated dataset for natural language reasoning with first-order logic, containing logically complex examples paired with premises and conclusions verified by an FOL inference engine, also serving as a NL-FOL translation dataset.
reputation: A well-known reasoning dataset for first-order logic and natural language inference that is used in research on logical reasoning and NL-to-FOL translation.
notes: Includes both natural language reasoning and NL to FOL translation tasks; challenges even advanced LLMs like GPT-4.
